ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with black dominating the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark (low-intensity) macro-pigmentation across both visible lobes, with high-contrast white contiguous blobs localized strictly at the distal tips and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a pixel convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations; right lobe exhibits extreme high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys indicating severe structural loss.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe displays a standard convex parabolic curve; right lobe displays a truncated, vertical-trending irregular trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groupings (barnacles) localized on the outer margin of the left lobe and heavily along the truncated edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural truncation of the right fluke lobe; the distal portion is missing, replaced by an irregular, heavily serrated boundary colonized by epibionts.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentrations of white/beige barnacle clusters specifically tracing the site of major tissue trauma on the right lobe.
